Dated : 23rd December, 2025.

P. C. :-
1) Heard the Counsel for the Petitioner and perused the charge- sheet filed on completion of investigation of CR No.482 of 2022 registered with Wakad Police Station, Pune invoking Sections 498A, 313, 323, 504 r/w. Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2) The subject FIR came to be registered at the instance of the complainant, levelling accusations against her own husband, mother-in- law, sister-in-law (present Petitioner) and father-in-law.

sentences.text: The complaint comprising of vague allegations without any specifications, resulted in invocation of Section 498A of IPC along with the other provisions and this include the accusations against the present Petitioner who is the sister-in-law.

According to the learned Counsel for the Petitioner, the material in the charge-sheet, is short of establishing a charge against her under Section 498A of IPC and moreover she is not, in any way, accused of offence under Section 313 of IPC and according to her the only allegation leveled against her, is to be found when the complainant stated that when she delivered a child, her in-laws along with her sister-in-law visited their house and on visiting, the sister-in-law made a grievance that her gold chain was lost, indicating as if she had stolen.

This resulted into search of the room being carried out by her in-laws including the present Petitioner and it is alleged that she was accused that her son did not bring a good omen and therefore the chain was lost.

In short, the complainant alleged that the sister-in-law i.e. the present Writ Petitioner mentally harassed her by taunting at her and even her in-laws supported her in this accusation and started harassing her by saying that she should make good the loss caused to her.
Thereafter, her sister-in-law and father-in-law left for Nagpur but the mother-in-law continued to stay with her.
4) In light of the aforesaid accusation, the contention advanced is that the ingredients of Section 498A of IPC, by no stretch of imagination, are made out against the present Petitioner.

5) The learned Counsel representing the Respondent No.2, seeks some time which the Counsel for the Petitioner refused to grant since the Manoj 13-WP-2211-2023.doc present Petition is filed in the year 2023 and with the able assistance of the learned Counsel for the Petitioner and the learned APP, we have perused the charge-sheet.
Perusal of the charge-sheet clearly reveal that the registration of the FIR against the present Petitioner amounts to abuse of process of law and the only allegation levelled against her, is the one to which we have made a reference in the above paragraph and except this, there is not a single accusation levelled against her as to what act of her would amount to cruelty which is defined in the Explanation appended to Section 498A of IPC.
6) In our considered opinion, by no stretch of imagination, the act accused of would attract Section 498A of IPC and therefore, offence of harassment is not made out against her.

She is not accused of the offence under Sections 311 and 323 of IPC and therefore, according to us, prosecuting her in the trial would be nothing but amounting to abuse of process of law and we intend to prevent this by granting the relief in the prayer clause being quashing and setting-aside of the charge-sheet filed on 27/12/2022 in FIR No.482/2022 registered on 01/06/2022.
7) In the wake of the above, the Petition is made absolute.
